Mobile Application

Abserny Mobile

A gesture-driven, voice-first AI vision assistant for Android. Built with React Native and Expo SDK 54, powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite online and ML Kit on-device when offline.

v1.0 Live Android iOS — Pending

Overview

Abserny (أبصرني, "help me see") is a mobile application designed specifically for visually impaired users. The entire interface is operated by five gestures with no visual interaction required at any point, including during first-time setup. All output is spoken through the device's native TTS engine.

The app targets Android devices running API 26 (Android 8.0) or higher. An iOS build is pending Apple Developer Program enrollment.

↓
Download APK available at github.com/Abserny/Abserny-Mobile. Enable "Install from unknown sources" on your Android device before installing.

System Requirements

  • Platform: Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
  • RAM: 2 GB minimum, 3 GB recommended
  • Storage: 150 MB for the APK and on-device models
  • Camera: Rear camera required
  • Internet: Optional — required only for Gemini AI (online mode)

Installation

  1. Download abserny-v1.0.apk from the GitHub Releases page.
  2. On your Android device, go to Settings → Security → Unknown sources and enable it.
  3. Open the downloaded APK and tap Install.
  4. Launch Abserny — the app will speak the onboarding sequence automatically.
ℹ
First launch The first launch speaks a language picker (swipe right for English, swipe left for Arabic), then walks through all five gestures interactively. You must perform each gesture to advance. This requires no sighted assistance.

Gesture Controls

The entire application is controlled by five gestures detected by PanResponder on a full-screen invisible touch surface. No buttons, no menus, no visual interaction.

Double Tap
Trigger a scan and receive a spoken description of the current scene. 320 ms recognition window. Works in READY state only.
Long Press
Repeat the last spoken description immediately. Activates after 700 ms hold. Isolated from double tap by timer.
Swipe Right
Cycle forward through detection modes: Scene → Object → Read → People → Scene. 60 px threshold, 1.2:1 horizontal ratio required.
Swipe Left
Cycle backward through detection modes. Same thresholds as swipe right.
Triple Tap
Open the spoken Settings overlay. Navigate by swipe, confirm by double tap, close by long press. Available in READY state.

Detection Modes

Four modes are available, each with tailored Gemini prompts in Arabic and English. Swipe left or right to cycle between them. The current mode is announced when changed.

Scene
Broad environmental awareness. Hazards and obstacles mentioned first. Up to 4 items, always including directional words (ahead, to your left, nearby).
Object
Close-range identification. Returns the precise object name plus one functional detail. Ideal for items on a table or shelf.
Read
On-device OCR via ML Kit. Reads all visible text verbatim, top to bottom. For signs, labels, documents, and packaging.
People
Social navigation. Reports count, spatial location, and observable activity of people in frame.

FSM Architecture

All interaction is governed by a deterministic finite state machine (FSM). This makes it structurally impossible for two scans to run simultaneously or for gesture events to conflict.

BOOT
App initializing — camera, TTS engine, PanResponder, and FSM supervisor loading. Transitions to READY automatically.
READY
Idle. Full-screen gesture surface active. Waiting for double tap. Long press repeats last result. Triple tap opens Settings.
SCANNING
Frame captured. Online path: sent to Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite. Offline path: ML Kit on-device labeling. All gestures blocked.
SPEAKING
TTS engine speaking the spatial description. Long press interrupts and repeats. Swipe changes mode. Double tap queues next scan.
ERROR
API timeout or network failure. App speaks an error message, then auto-recovers to READY within 2 seconds.

AI and Detection Pipeline

Online — Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite

When connected to the internet, Abserny sends a JPEG frame to the Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite API with a mode-specific, language-specific prompt. The model returns a concise spatial description in the user's chosen language with a median end-to-end latency of 1,430 ms on a mid-range Android device.

Prompts are written in Arabic for Arabic mode and English for English mode. Prompting in the target language produces significantly more natural, idiomatic spatial phrasing than translating an English response.

Offline — ML Kit

When offline or when the Gemini API is unavailable, Abserny silently and automatically falls back to Google ML Kit on-device image labeling and text recognition. Offline median latency is 380 ms with a 0% failure rate across 50 test trials.

AbserneyVision (Custom Model)

An additional offline detection layer using a custom MobileNetV2 model trained via transfer learning on ImageNet and Microsoft COCO. Targets 13 common indoor object categories. Current validation accuracy is 37% — dataset expansion is ongoing toward a target of 80%+. See AbserneyVision documentation for training details.

Text-to-Speech

Abserny uses the Android native TTS engine via expo-speech. A custom speech queue with priority interruption ensures that a new scan immediately replaces any ongoing speech without delay.

  • Arabic: ar-SA, speech rate 0.82
  • English: en-US, speech rate 0.88

Language and Onboarding

Language selection happens during first launch through a fully spoken interface. The app asks the user to swipe right for English or left for Arabic, then confirms with a double tap. This choice is saved and never asked again.

The interactive gesture tutorial follows — each gesture is explained and the user must perform it to advance. The onboarding sequence requires zero sighted assistance from the very first second.

Language can be changed at any time via the spoken Settings menu (triple tap in READY state).

Technology Stack

  • React Native / Expo SDK 54 — hooks-based architecture, each concern (speech, gesture, detection, language) in its own independent hook
  • Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite — online vision, free tier, no cost barrier
  • ML Kit (Google) — on-device image labeling and OCR, no API key required
  • expo-speech — native Android TTS with priority queue
  • PanResponder — full-screen gesture detection
  • AsyncStorage — persisting language choice and onboarding state

Repository
